Per our policy, the annual-fee rebate ($150) requires meeting the monthly spend threshold of $7,500.00 in every single monthly window; one missed month disqualifies the whole year.

I looked through your Platinum Rewards Card transactions that posted during that cardmember year. Summing posted purchases by each monthly window, the month starting 11/10/2024 (transactions on 11/10, 11/12, 11/20, 11/24) totals about $7,235.26 — which is below the required $7,500 threshold for that month. Because that month did not meet the $7,500 requirement, your account is not eligible for the annual-fee rebate for the 11/10/2024–11/9/2025 cardmember year.

If you’d like, I can:
- Run and share a month-by-month breakdown showing the posted totals I used for each of the 12 monthly windows; or
- Check whether any pending or recently posted transactions (or refunds that posted later) might affect the totals; or
- Transfer you to a human agent to review further.
